title: Scenario B: Conflicting Picture in Grid Sector 7 (Primary Demo)
description: Multi-source reconnaissance reports contradictory movement signatures during an active forward reconnaissance patrol. Source A reports mechanized advance, Source B reports intermittent decoy radar doppler, and Source C HUMINT reports false acoustic emitters.
learning_objectives: Identify and cross-reference divergent intelligence feeds under temporal delay
Synthesize conflicting sensor metadata and source reliability profiles
Resolve information asymmetry between Team Lead and Specialist roles before committing assets

roles.title: Task Force Lead Commander
roles.description: Has final dispatch and operational engagement authority for Sector 7.

roles.title: Tactical Operations & Fire Support Officer
roles.description: Liaises between intelligence sensors, artillery coordinates, and maneuver units.

roles.title: Electronic Warfare & Signals Intelligence Specialist
roles.description: Interprets sensor spectral signatures, radar Doppler metrics, and decoy spoofing.

payload.heading: SOUTH_WEST_AXIS_BRAVO
payload.summary: Eagle-1 visual confirms 6 vehicles on Axis Bravo moving toward Sector 7 bridgehead.
Sentinel Radar returns indicate intermittent RCS (radar cross section) inconsistent with heavy armor.

payload.observation: Axis Bravo convoy is unmanned tractor decoys with RF loudspeakers. Actual hostile force concealed on Ridge Charlie!

parameters.opposing_claim: Convoy on Axis Bravo is primary hostile assault echelon.

decision_points.prompt: Eagle-1 insists mechanized convoy is advancing on Axis Bravo bridgehead. Information Specialist reports decoy Doppler and OP Echo warns of ambush at Ridge Charlie. Team Lead must issue immediate sub-unit order:

options.label: Commit Quick Reaction Force to Axis Bravo
options.description: Commit forward combat assets to intercept the visible convoy on Axis Bravo immediately.

options.label: Hold Bridgehead & Request OP-Echo Cross-Verification
options.description: Maintain defensive posture at bridgehead while ordering signals specialist to authenticate Doppler anomaly.

options.label: Preemptive Recon Flank to Ridge Charlie
options.description: Redirect secondary scout patrol to probe Ridge Charlie while screening Axis Bravo with smoke.

outcome_rules.narrative: Quick Reaction Force engaged decoy tractor trucks on Axis Bravo. Real hostile detachment on Ridge Charlie opened enfilade fire from high ground.
outcome_rules.ground_truth_fact: Axis Bravo was a deliberate electronic decoy designed to draw defense assets away from Ridge Charlie.

outcome_rules.narrative: Sub-unit held position. Signals analysis confirmed synthetic RF broadcast, preventing ambush. Hostile force at Ridge Charlie was neutralized by pre-planned artillery.
outcome_rules.ground_truth_fact: Holding bridgehead allowed OP-Echo HUMINT and Radar Doppler metadata to merge, confirming the decoy.

outcome_rules.narrative: Flanking force surprised hostile ambushers at Ridge Charlie, capturing communication gear intact.
outcome_rules.ground_truth_fact: Hostile ambush at Ridge Charlie was vulnerable on its eastern reverse slope.
